text: PMB Integrated Library System – Nepal Knowledge Center Services Skip to content Home Services Reviews Why Us FAQs Contact Main Menu Contact Us DSpace FAQs Home Koha Moodle PMB Integrated Library System Why Us PMB Integrated Library System Developer(s)                      PMB Services Initial release                     October 2003; 21 years ago Repository                         forge.sigb.net/redmine/projects/pmb/files Framework                        Apache, MySql, PHP Operating system              Linux, Windows, Mac OS Type                                   Integrated library system License                               Free/Open Source Website                              www.sigb.net Target audience : PMB is suitable for small and medium sized libraries with collection of up to 500,000 (five lac) titles.  In particlular, it is ideal for school and college libraries. It is very simple to install and run PMB on a local Windows computer; no need for expertise in Linux system. PMB’s user friendly interface means that even non-professional staff can learn to use the system easily and quickly. PMB  is open source Integrated Library System including Cataloging, Circulation, Acquisitions, Administration, OPAC etc. In addition it includes Selective Dissemination of Information (SDI) module which is not normally found in other ILS. PMB demo site for Staff : https://nkcs.org.np/pmb/demo user:pmbdemo pw: Pass123$ It is only ILS that has OPAC with built in content management system CMS for the management of the library website. For an example of this,  please visit CDC library: Curriculum Development Centre PMB can  also  manage Digital Library (eLibrary) together with traditional library. For an example of eLibrary using PMB see  World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Library website: https://library.wmo.int Regarding Serials cataloging,  PMB allows NepJol like user interface for cataloging, browsing and  searching of of serials. Example: Ministry of Federal Affairs and General Administration PMB is based on library rules and standards. uses the Z39.50 protocol (in order to import bibliographic records that can be directly integrated in the database from different servers).  It manages the UNIMARC cataloguing format and the ISO 2709 record exchange format. It also includes the XML data format.  PMB is also OAI server and client. Copyright © 2026 Nepal Knowledge Center Services | Powered by Astra WordPress Theme Scroll to Top
